description: Sampled reveal one-shots and authentic Pokémon game cries; no anime voice impersonation, dialogue, songs, or generated oscillator loops.

criesSource.kind: Latest game cries, not anime voices
criesSource.upstream: PokeAPI README identifies Pokémon Showdown, Veekun and The Sounds Resource as upstream sources.
criesSource.rights: Pokémon/game audio included under user's stated license; PokeAPI is a community mirror, not the rights holder.
criesSource.processing: Complete cry retained; peak normalization, 3ms attack/80ms tail fade, stereo 48kHz OGG Opus and 44.1kHz MP3 encoding.

releaseProvenance.status: Community-uploaded Poké Ball opening sample; original episode, sound-library source, and uploader chain of custody not independently verified.
releaseProvenance.selection: First 1.8 seconds after the initial 0.54-second silence lead-in from MyInstants uploader nauth. This is an excerpt of the source recording, not a newly synthesized substitute.
releaseProvenance.validation: Audio format, duration, decoding, source attribution and output peak checks verified. Automated tooling here does not provide human listening review.

recommendedPlayback: MP3 provides broad Safari compatibility; OGG alternate supplied. Start cries/release at gain 0.55, power layers at 0.3 and UI at 0.35; avoid playing several full-gain effects together.

processing.mastering: Stereo; sample peak normalized to -4 dBFS; edge fades; protective limiter; 48kHz OGG Opus at 128kbps and 44.1kHz MP3 at 192kbps
